claim_status: engineering diagnostic only; no board-game strength, transfer, or JEPA comparison

environment.compute: local CPU; no cloud or paid hardware
environment.data: procedurally generated online from a project-owned seven-state deterministic game; no external data
environment.game: Count Up N=7, actions add 1 or 2, alternating zero-sum, terminal on reaching/exceeding 7

exact_target: backward-induction quantal-response fixed point with temperature alpha

metric_semantics.learned_policy: network policy pi_theta returned by model.predict
metric_semantics.improvement_target: one-step regularized policy target pi_prime, reported separately
metric_semantics.q_mae: learned action-value head against exact target Q

limitations: single synthetic finite game with seven states
no held-out games, opponents, or generalization split
no JEPA model or non-JEPA ablation comparison
no statistical superiority, board-game strength, or paper-reproduction claim
exploratory engineering diagnostic; not locked confirmatory evidence
